events.title: Excessive bank below 500 ft
events.description: Initial tier from the FOQA rule research: more than 15 deg below 500 ft. Higher levels are a FOQA-Sim estimate.

events.title: Bounced landing
events.description: More than one main-gear air-to-ground transition (EASA EOFDM RE30).

events.title: Hard landing (light aircraft)
events.description: Peak normal load at touchdown, light aircraft (normal-category limit load 3.8 g). Levels are a FOQA-Sim estimate.

events.title: Long landing
events.description: Touchdown beyond the touchdown zone, whose length is min(3000 ft, LDA/3) of the landing runway (sources to be confirmed: FAA P/CG 3000 ft, one-third rule). Needs the airport data recorded in flight.

events.title: Touchdown off the runway centreline
events.description: Distance of the touchdown from the runway centreline. Levels are a FOQA-Sim estimate. Needs the airport data recorded in flight.
